query: What are Yahoo's Day 1 onboarding requirements, annual PTO and rollover allowances, and the monthly wellness stipend for full-time employees?
ground_truth:
1. Day 1 Onboarding Requirements: Complete security training and request system hardware permissions (Onboarding Guide).
2. PTO & Rollover Allowances: Full-time employees receive 25 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per calendar year, 5 floating holidays, and can roll over a maximum of 5 unused PTO days per year with excess expiring Dec 31 (Yahoo Employee Handbook).
3. Wellness Stipend: Full-time employees receive a $150 per month wellness stipend for gym or fitness classes (Benefits Summary).
description: Multi-datasource cross-policy verification (Day 1 onboarding, PTO, and wellness)

query: How much is the wellness stipend and what expenses qualify for monthly reimbursement?
ground_truth: Eligible full-time employees receive up to $150 per month reimbursement for health and fitness expenses including gym memberships, fitness classes, athletic shoes, workout equipment, and mental health apps.
description: Wellness stipend policy and eligible expense categories

query: How do I use python at Yahoo and what are the recommended tools for virtual environments and linting?
ground_truth: Standardize Python on uv or python3 -m venv for virtual environments, ruff for linting and code formatting, pytest for unit tests, and configure ~/.pip/pip.conf to use the internal Artifactory mirror (artifactory.yahoo.com).
description: Python tooling, virtual environment setup, and Artifactory mirror

query: How do TLS certificates work at Yahoo and can internal services still support TLS 1.0 or TLS 1.1?
ground_truth: Authentication and encryption are enforced via Yahoo Certificate Authority (YCA) digital signatures and TLS handshakes. TLS 1.0 and 1.1 were sunset in October 2020; all microservices and edge gateways must enforce TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3 minimum.
description: TLS certificate authority management and protocol deprecation rules

query: Compare the PTO rollover rules with the wellness stipend monthly rollover policy.
ground_truth: PTO allows rolling over up to 5 unused days into the next calendar year, whereas the wellness stipend ($150/mo) is strictly use-it-or-lose-it with zero rollover.
description: Cross-policy comparison of PTO carryover versus monthly wellness stipend rollover
